• **Role & Background:** Dr. Shiv Prasad Kosta is an eminent Indian space scientist, educationist, and technocrat. Born in Garha, Jabalpur, he served in distinguished national scientific roles before guiding the academic establishment of Shri Ram Group in 2001. At ISRO, he served as Deputy Director for India’s historic first satellite project, Aryabhata, and as Group Director at the ISRO Satellite Centre in Bangalore, collaborating with Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam and former CEC T. N. Seshan. He served as Director in the Department of Electronics (now MeitY, Govt of India) from 1987 to 1990, Vice-Chancellor of Jabalpur University (Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya) from 1990 to 1994, and Director General of M.M. Vedic University until 2000. He is documented across official college records as Group Director / Director General leading the academic and institutional vision of the Shri Ram Group.

messages.content: Tell me about the cricket one

The cricket initiative at SRIT is the **Engineering Premier League (EPL)**. Here are the key details:

### **Overview**
The **Engineering Premier League (EPL)** is SRIT's premier annual cricket tournament and championship. It is one of the most prominent sporting events in the Mahakoshal region, bringing together students from various engineering branches (B.Tech, M.Tech) and colleges.

---

### **Key Highlights & Features**
* **Professional Match Setup:** Features dedicated college cricket grounds, professional pitches, certified umpire officiating, live scoring, and commentary.
* **Recognition & Awards:** Trophies for winning teams, runners-up, along with individual awards such as Player of the Match, Best Batsman, Best Bowler, and Player of the Tournament.
* **Tournaments:** Organizes both inter-branch competitions and inter-collegiate tournaments in tennis-ball and leather-ball formats.

---

### **Key Activities**
* **Annual EPL Tournament:** The flagship championship event.
* **Inter-Branch Leagues:** Friendly yet competitive matches between departments (CSE, ME, Civil, EC, etc.).
* **Selection Trials:** Regular trials to select the official SRIT College Cricket Team for university (RGPV) and regional sports meets.
* **Net Practice Sessions:** Regular training and practice sessions on the college ground.

---

### **Eligibility & How to Join**
* **Eligibility:** Open to all registered SRIT students across all years and branches.
* **Contact:** You can get involved by connecting with the **Sports Officer / Faculty Coordinator in the Physical Education Department** on campus.

knowledge.title: About Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT)
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) is one of the premier engineering and professional educational institutions in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. Founded under the aegis of the Shri Ram Group, the institute provides quality higher education in engineering, technology, computer applications, and management. SRIT is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi, and is affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal for engineering programs, and Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya (RDVV), Jabalpur for management and computer applications.

knowledge.title: History & Establishment of Shri Ram Group and SRIT
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Group officially came into existence on 9 July 2001. Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) was established in 2001 as its pioneer engineering institution in Jabalpur, under the academic leadership of space scientist Dr. S. P. Kosta (former Deputy Director of ISRO Aryabhata project). Over two decades, the group expanded into a premier multi-disciplinary campus with institutions in Engineering (SRIT, SRIST), Pharmacy (SRIP), MCA, and Management.

knowledge.title: Founder, Ownership & Governance of SRIT
knowledge.content: The official website states that Shri Ram Group came into existence on 9 July 2001 and identifies Dr. S. P. Kosta as its Group Director / Director General leading the academic vision of the group. The institute is governed by its officially appointed Governing Body and Board of Governors in accordance with AICTE and RGPV regulatory guidelines. Official sources document administrative leadership (Group Director Dr. S. P. Kosta, Principal Dr. Shailesh Gupta, and Chairman/Governing Body), but do not publicly designate a private individual as legal personal "owner".

knowledge.title: SRIT Location & Campus Address
knowledge.content: SRIT is located at Near I.T.I, Madhotal, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh - 482002, India. The campus is well-connected to Jabalpur Railway Station (approx. 8 km) and Jabalpur Airport (approx. 20 km), with dedicated college bus transit routes across the city.

knowledge.title: Courses & Programs Available at SRIT
knowledge.content: SRIT offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma degrees: 1. Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) - 4-year degree. 2. Master of Technology (M.Tech) - 2-year post-graduate degree in specialized engineering domains. 3. Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - professional software degree. 4. Master of Business Administration (MBA) - postgraduate management degree.

knowledge.title: B.Tech Branches at SRIT
knowledge.content: The B.Tech program offers specialization across major engineering disciplines: 1. Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) 2. Computer Science & Engineering - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (CSE - AI & ML) 3. Computer Science & Engineering - Data Science (CSE - DS) 4. Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) 5. Electrical Engineering (EE) 6. Mechanical Engineering (ME) 7. Civil Engineering (CE). All engineering programs follow the RGPV curriculum enriched with practical lab sessions, industry projects, and emerging technology electives.

knowledge.title: Admission Process & Eligibility
knowledge.content: Admissions to B.Tech are conducted primarily through the MP DTE (Directorate of Technical Education, Madhya Pradesh) centralized online counseling, based on JEE Main scores and 10+2 qualifying marks (minimum 45% aggregate in Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science/Biology for General category, and 40% for reserved categories). Direct college-level counseling (CLC) is also conducted as per DTE guidelines for vacant seats. Candidates for MCA require a recognized Bachelor degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level.

knowledge.title: Student Helpline & Official Contact Information
knowledge.content: Official College Contacts: Phone Helplines: +91 9755042292, +91 9755042293, 0761-4001933 / 36. Email: info@sritgroup.net. Campus Address: Shri Ram Institute of Technology, Near I.T.I, Madhotal, Jabalpur (M.P.) - 482002. Student support offices include the Academic Section, Examination Cell, Training & Placement Cell, and Student Grievance Redressal Committee.

knowledge.title: Campus Infrastructure & Facilities
knowledge.content: SRIT features a sprawling 30+ acre green campus with state-of-the-art facilities: 1. Central Library with more than 50,000 books, national & international journals, DELNET access, and digital library e-resources. 2. High-tech Computer Centers equipped with high-speed internet, modern workstations, and licensed software. 3. Well-equipped Departmental Laboratories & Mechanical Workshops. 4. Large Multi-purpose Auditorium and air-conditioned Seminar Halls with modern audio-visual systems. 5. College Canteen and cafeteria serving hygienic food and refreshments. 6. Fleet of 50+ college buses connecting all corners of Jabalpur and nearby regions. 7. Medical room with first-aid and visiting doctor. 8. Wi-Fi enabled academic blocks.

knowledge.title: Sports Facilities & Athletic Complex
knowledge.content: SRIT provides extensive sports facilities encouraging physical fitness and teamwork: dedicated Cricket ground (host to the renowned Engineering Premier League - EPL), Football field, Volleyball courts, Basketball court, Badminton courts, and indoor sports facilities including Table Tennis, Chess, and Carrom. Annual sports meets and inter-collegiate tournaments are held regularly.

knowledge.title: Engineering Premier League (EPL) - Cricket Tournament
knowledge.content: EPL stands for Engineering Premier League. It is the premier annual cricket tournament hosted by Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) in Jabalpur. The tournament brings together B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, and professional students from various engineering branches and colleges across the Mahakoshal region. It features professional cricket pitches, umpire officiating, trophies, player-of-the-match awards, and enthusiastic student participation.

knowledge.title: Occulus - SRIT Rock Band & Music Society
knowledge.content: Occulus is the official Battle of Rock Bands and music society of Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) Jabalpur. Founded and run by enthusiastic student musicians, Occulus provides a platform for vocalists, guitarists, drummers, and keyboardists to perform and collaborate. The Occulus band performs live during college fests, sports inaugurations, NCC parades, and inter-collegiate cultural festivals.

knowledge.title: Vahini - Women Empowerment Forum
knowledge.content: Vahini is the dedicated Women Empowerment Initiative launched by Shri Ram Institute of Technology under the mentorship of senior faculty including Mrs. Mona Jain. Vahini unites female students, faculty members, and staff to promote gender sensitization, leadership, self-defense workshops, health awareness drives, career mentorship, and social outreach for underprivileged girl children.

knowledge.title: Dance Club (SRIT Rhythm)
knowledge.content: The Dance Club at SRIT coordinates dance enthusiasts across Classical, Western, Contemporary, Hip-Hop, and Folk styles. Members rehearse regularly and represent SRIT at university youth festivals, annual social gatherings, and state-level dance battles.

knowledge.title: Training & Placement Cell (T&P) Activities
knowledge.content: The Training and Placement (T&P) Cell at SRIT works actively to prepare students for campus recruitment. T&P activities include: 1. Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, and verbal ability training. 2. Technical mock interviews and coding assessments. 3. Soft skills and group discussion grooming sessions. 4. Campus recruitment drives by leading IT and core engineering companies. 5. Industry interaction, expert lectures, and summer internship coordination.

knowledge.title: Activities for First-Year Students
knowledge.content: First-year students at SRIT (including B.Tech AIML, CSE, DS, and other branches) can participate in a wide array of activities: 1. Join student clubs such as Occulus (Music), Dance Club, Sports Club, and Vahini. 2. Participate in the annual EPL Cricket tournament trials and sports meets. 3. Attend technical coding bootcamps, AI/ML workshops, and robotics demonstrations. 4. Compete in TechFest events (quiz, paper presentation, coding competitions). 5. Take part in National Service Scheme (NSS), blood donation camps, and campus green drives.

knowledge.title: AIML Student Guide & Opportunities at SRIT
knowledge.content: For B.Tech students specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AIML): SRIT provides dedicated AI/ML computing labs with GPU acceleration, Python & Data Science environments, and machine learning toolkits. institutions.name: Shri Ram Group
institutions.description: Shri Ram Group is a major educational group based in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. The group came into existence on 9 July 2001 and encompasses institutions in Engineering, Technology, Pharmacy, Management, and Computer Applications.
institutions.history: Shri Ram Group came into existence on 9 July 2001. Guided by eminent technocrat and space scientist Dr. S. P. Kosta, the group started with its flagship engineering institute (SRIT) and subsequently expanded into science, technology, pharmacy, and management disciplines.

institutions.name: Shri Ram Institute of Technology
institutions.description: Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) is the flagship engineering institute of the Shri Ram Group, offering Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech), Master of Technology (M.Tech), MCA, and MBA degrees in Jabalpur.
institutions.approval: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi
institutions.history: SRIT was established in 2001 as the pioneer engineering college of the Mahakoshal region, promoted by the Shri Ram Group under the academic guidance of Dr. S. P. Kosta.

institutions.history: Established to provide pharmaceutical sciences education under Shri Ram Group.

persons.title: Dr.
persons.qualifications: Ph.D., Renowned Indian Space Scientist & Technocrat
persons.biography: Dr. Shiv Prasad Kosta is an eminent Indian space scientist, educationist, and technocrat. Born in Garha, Jabalpur, he served in distinguished national scientific roles before guiding the academic establishment of Shri Ram Group in 2001. At ISRO, he served as Deputy Director for India’s historic first satellite project, Aryabhata, and as Group Director at the ISRO Satellite Centre in Bangalore, collaborating with Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam and former CEC T. N. Seshan. He served as Director in the Department of Electronics (now MeitY, Govt of India) from 1987 to 1990, Vice-Chancellor of Jabalpur University (Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya) from 1990 to 1994, and Director General of M.M. Vedic University until 2000. He is documented across official college records as Group Director / Director General leading the academic and institutional vision of the Shri Ram Group.
persons.experience: Deputy Director for ISRO Aryabhata Satellite Project; Group Director at ISRO Satellite Centre; Director at Department of Electronics (Govt of India, 1987-1990); Vice-Chancellor of Jabalpur University (1990-1994); Director General of M.M. Vedic University (until 2000); Group Director of Shri Ram Group (2001-present). Author of ~10 books on Indian satellites and space missions.
persons.achievements: Key leader in launching India’s first satellite Aryabhata; pioneer of engineering education in Mahakoshal region; authored ~10 books on satellite communications and electronics.
persons.source: Official Shri Ram Group Website (Group Director Message) & Scientific Bio Records

persons.title: Dr.
persons.biography: Dr. Shailesh Gupta is the Principal of Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT), Jabalpur. He oversees the academic curriculum, institutional governance, RGPV university compliance, faculty development, and student welfare across all undergraduate and postgraduate engineering departments.
persons.experience: Over two decades of academic administration, engineering research, university curriculum coordination, and institutional accreditation leadership.

persons.title: Dr.
persons.biography: Dr. Vivek Rajput serves as the Training and Placement Officer (TPO) and Head of the Training & Placement Cell for Shri Ram Group. He coordinates corporate campus placement drives, technical aptitude training, soft skills development, internship coordination, and industry-academia liaisons for SRIT students.
persons.experience: Extensive corporate relations, campus recruitment coordination, student career counseling, and corporate partnership development.
persons.source: Official Shri Ram Group Placement Cell
